name: The Plague
source:
Her father's life hangs by a thread. A stranger in a mask may hold the cure… or the dagger.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
她的父親命懸一線。那蒙面陌生人手裡握著的，或許是解藥……也可能是匕首。
